hypothesis: At the sole unresolved field of 52.8 Td, extending the unchanged seeded trajectory to a 1.6 microsecond measurement window produces no greater than 5% drift half-window change, no greater than 5% drift relative standard error, and preserves the previously locked experimental pass.
selection_rule: Run only 52.8 Td because it is the sole failed numerical gate in the five-field extended result; no experimental residual was used to choose a new field.

acceptance.experimental_comparison_rule: Use the 52.8 Td row from the checksum-locked local reference and require abs(simulation-reference) <= 0.20*abs(reference) + 2*simulation_standard_error

classification: Passing closes the sole remaining numerical gate for the five-field Phelps-based historical experimental consistency checkpoint by inheritance from the unchanged passing fields. It does not add an independent seed.
claim_boundary: The result remains a same-seed extension and a historical calibration-consistency check with temperature, coefficient-convention, and experimental-uncertainty limitations.
